Senses.PreferredTarget: if you will not go downhill, the opportune moment is hard to meet
AlternateTargets: refuse the downhill path and miss the quick chance
SearchAliases: will not take the easy opening
Senses.Note: The line is preserved as one causal pair; its downhill scene does not establish a general rule about ease or effort.

Senses.Explanation: Refusing to walk when the ground slopes downward means failing to take an opening already made easy; the paired warning says such an opportune moment is hard to meet again. Foguo Weibai closes a hall question with the whole pair. Dahui Zonggao adds it after supplying a name in the Huangbo–Pei Xiu case, and a later case anthology preserves that same comment. Donglin Changzong gives the pair itself as his answer to “what is the unmoving honored one?”
